confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live menu, listing, or rate checks; July high-season prices are extrapolated from general knowledge. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain. Cocktail and wine were set as a typical multiple of the beer anchor because direct Canggu venue knowledge is limited. FX came from search-result summaries citing the RBA overview page; that page was not opened, so verify the 2026-10-15 value against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Regional basis is Bali tourist-hub pricing (Seminyak and Ubud as reference points), with a Canggu café and surf-tourism premium and a July high-season uplift on accommodation.
